Markets.title: US stocks: Capricor shares 70% soar as potential FDA lifeline revives Duchenne drug hopes
Markets.summary: Capricor Therapeutics shares surged 70% after the FDA agreed to review new 24-month data for its experimental Duchenne muscular dystrophy treatment. This review revives hopes for the drug, which focuses on improving upper limb muscle function following setbacks last month.

Markets.title: US stocks: Reddit surges 14% on S&P 500 inclusion, set to replace AvalonBay
Markets.summary: Reddit stock surged 14% after it was announced that the company will join the S&P 500 index on August 18. Reddit will replace AvalonBay Communities in the index, triggering massive share purchases by index funds.

Markets.title: US stocks: US market opens mixed as investors weigh Middle East tensions, data
Markets.summary: US stocks opened mixed on Friday following a record high for the S&P 500. Investors evaluated the latest retail sales data alongside ongoing Middle East tensions.

Markets.title: Cochin Shipyard Q1 Results: Profit falls 19% YoY to Rs 151 crore, revenue up marginally
Markets.summary: Cochin Shipyard reported a 19.4% year-on-year decline in consolidated profit to Rs 151.5 crore for the first quarter, despite a marginal 2.3% increase in revenue. The company also experienced a 20.4% drop in EBITDA, lower profit margins, and disclosed regulatory fines regarding its board composition.

Markets.title: Sebi revises InvIT cash flow framework to allow adding back external debt-funded maintenance costs
Markets.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India now allows Infrastructure Investment Trusts to add back external debt-funded maintenance costs for road projects. This regulatory update gives InvITs more financial flexibility, provided they obtain unitholder consent for any new maintenance debt.

Markets.title: Anchor investors stay put after IPO lock-in, but half their bets are gone within a year: Sebi
Markets.summary: A SEBI study of 242 IPOs revealed that anchor investors sell about half their allocated shares within one year of the lock-in period expiring. Foreign Portfolio Investors had the highest exit rate, and investors sold out of smaller IPOs the fastest.

Geo-Political.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
Geo-Political.summary: Unprecedented rain in Japan has killed eight people and left over 20,000 households without power. The severe storm also stranded 7,000 people at Tokyo's Narita airport.

Geo-Political.title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC podcast uncovered a network of Instagram accounts glamourising the swim around the Morocco-Ceuta border fence. These profiles are reportedly providing paid advice to help migrants cross into the Spanish territory.

Geo-Political.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
Geo-Political.summary: A new U.S. report reveals that dozens of countries helped China route goods through lower-tariff nations to evade U.S. tariffs. This practice allowed Chinese exporters to bypass higher trade levies imposed during the Trump administration.

Geo-Political.title: Builders unearth €9m gold loot sealed in walls of Belgian property
Geo-Political.summary: Construction workers in Belgium discovered nine million euros in gold hidden inside the walls of a cellar. The stash was found while the workers were drilling to lay sewage pipes.

Geo-Political.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian police arrested a man after recovering eight stolen artworks by French artist Henri Matisse. The pieces were found inside a home located in the greater São Paulo area.

Geo-Political.title: Presidential vote counting halted in Zambia over alleged attacks on polling staff
Geo-Political.summary: Zambian election officials have suspended the counting of presidential votes due to violence and the theft of marked ballot papers. The electoral commission reported that these attacks targeted polling staff.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift toward AI optimization (AIO) alongside traditional SEO for generating organic traffic.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. It also provides tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools from 2023 designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflow efficiency. These widely used market solutions cater to various applications, including natural language processing.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article highlights the benefits of using AI content generators to create effective and engaging material for audiences. It notes that numerous tools are available on the market, making it challenging to choose the right one.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also provides examples of top programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for primary articles and manufactured products both increased compared to June.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, total merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-over-year to $173.78 billion.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst expectations and could provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, compounded by the risks of elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong growth outlook, while projecting a 6.4% GDP growth rate. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also emphasizes that improving employability is a greater challenge for India than simply creating jobs.

India.title: Bigger Than Sanchi? Ujjain May Be Sitting On 2,200-Year-Old Buddhist Mystery
India.summary: A newly discovered mound in Ujjain may hold a 2,200-year-old Buddhist stupa. This structure is estimated to be significantly larger than the Great Stupa at Sanchi.

India.title: 'My Remarks Misused With Malicious Intent': Chief Justice On 'Cockroach' Row
India.summary: Chief Justice of India stated that his previous "cockroach" remark was misused with malicious intent after sparking widespread youth backlash. The controversy inspired a satirical online movement named the "Cockroach Janta Party."

India.title: Mumbai Man Killed After Being Run Over By Bike Following Heated Argument
India.summary: A Mumbai man named Lalit Tungariya was killed on August 12 after being intentionally run over by a speeding motorcycle. The fatal incident occurred near Triveni Bar following a heated argument between the victim and the rider.

India.title: Local BJP Leader, 52, Found Murdered In Assam, 5 Arrested
India.summary: Bikash Dhar, a 52-year-old local BJP leader in Assam, was found murdered in an abandoned house near the Tripura border. Police have arrested five people in connection with the killing.

India.title: "Share Deep And Strong Ties With Italy": Centre On Congress' Meloni Jibe
India.summary: The Indian government stated that India and Italy share deep, strong ties based on mutual respect and understanding. This response from the Centre followed a jibe made by the Congress party regarding Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni.

India.title: UP Board Compartment Result 2026 Soon: Check Class 10th, 12th Result Expected Date
India.summary: The UP Board will soon release the compartment exam results for Class 10 and Class 12 students for the year 2026. Students can check the expected release date, exam statistics, login credentials, and steps to view their scores.

General.title: Temporary ban on sale of disposable BBQs over wildfire risk
General.summary: The government has temporarily banned the sale of disposable barbecues due to the severe wildfire risk posed by ongoing drought and heatwave conditions. Officials warn that these single-use grills present a significant danger to public safety.

General.title: Farage faces renewed watchdog probe after Clacton by-election victory
General.summary: Nigel Farage is facing a reopened investigation by parliamentary watchdogs regarding a £5 million gift. This inquiry resumes following his victory in the Clacton by-election.

General.title: Prisoners charged over attack on Sara Sharif's father
General.summary: Two inmates, Steven Sansom and Adam Watson, have been charged over an attack on Sara Sharif's father in Belmarsh Prison. Both men face additional charges relating to the same incident.

General.title: Eurovision proposes new rules to reduce political voting
General.summary: Eurovision organizers plan to introduce new rules to combat persistent and deeply worrying political voting. The proposed changes aim to reduce the impact of geopolitical biases on the competition's results.

General.title: 'Glam helps mentality' says sprinter Amy Hunt, but can it give you that winning edge?
General.summary: Sprinter Amy Hunt displayed her manicured nails at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham. She stated that such glamour helps her mentality during competition.

General.title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta migrant crisis with paid advice for help to cross
General.summary: A network of Instagram accounts is encouraging the migrant crisis at the Morocco-Ceuta border by glamourising the swim around the fence. These profiles are offering paid advice on how to cross the border.
